title: E.l.f. Brands to open Hote.l.f. pop-up with Palm Tree Club & Hotel for Art Basel Miami
summary: E.l.f. Cosmetics, e.l.f. SKIN and e.l.f. Hair products will be showcased at the five-day event, which aims to position the brand within a ‘major cultural moment’

title: Givaudan, Firmenich and IFF fined more than €500 million over fragrance cartel
summary: Investigations by the European Commission (EC) and UK Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) found that the world’s three largest fragrance producers shared commercially sensitive information, breaking competition rules

title: Sephora issues last application call for second edition of the Sephora Prize
summary: Applications will remain open until 30 November, with winners able to benefit from mentoring and retail acceleration opportunities with the LVMH-owned beauty retailer

title: Biodance founder Mihwa Kim on the viral brand’s social media success and global expansion plans
summary: Mihwa Kim created Biodance following a car crash – now the Korean skin care brand is the latest to look at global domination thanks to its satisfying hydrogel formulas and cult social media following

title: Joonbyrd conquered advanced body care, but can it crack the hair care market?
summary: After reporting a ‘stellar’ 100% year-on-year ecommerce growth, Joonbyrd – the body care brand founded by dermatologist Dr Alexis Granite, powered by clinically proven actives and mood-supportive scents – will enter the hair care category in 2027 with scalp health-focused products, as well as expand its US reach

title: Exclusive: How Undead Beauty is bringing discarded cosmetics back from the brink
summary: As beauty’s overconsumption problem grows, one new brand is giving forgotten products a second life. Here is how Undead Beauty is bringing unloved and unused make-up products back from the afterlife

title: Missha opens first UK pop-up in Bristol via Boots
summary: The Korean skin care and make-up brand is taking over Boots’ Bristol Cabot Circus Store for a three-day event, inviting consumers to discover the brand’s range of K-beauty products, including skin care and its hero BB Cream, M Perfect Cover Serum BB Cream Pro

title: SID MEDICOS moves to expand LemonBottle distribution and strengthen supply in Japan
summary: New distribution channels will build on the brand’s existing network in Japan, with a phased expansion planned according to regional demand and distribution conditions; plans also include stronger product information and authenticity guidance, alongside global portfolio development in aftercare and cooling skincare

title: Vitamin C body care: the brightening skin care active is moving below the face
summary: As body care becomes results-led, vitamin C is the trusted ingredient leading launch innovation, with brands bringing proven brightening benefits below the chin
